notes: DESIGN (per spec/evolution/runs/evo-003-wave-e-eligibility.json): socket.io 4.8.3 (registry-verified MIT) chosen as an INDEPENDENT third-party realtime server product (the engine.io protocol — its own handshake/sid, transports, ping liveness, rooms, disconnect semantics) — the strongest honest substitution evidence against LiveKit's signal protocol through ONE neutral port + ONE conformance contract; ws 8.21.3 was the recorded fallback (never needed); centrifugo deferred (no verifiable npm artifact under the zero-drift rule)

THE ADAPTER EMBEDS THE SERVER (the honest self-hosted form): the published socket.io server package boots IN PROCESS on loopback; the adapter is the privileged authority (the grant-verifying handshake middleware + the channel registry + the dispatch-only rail handlers) and performs every upstream side effect through a REAL dispatch connection (a socket.io client over loopback WebSocket, authenticated by a short-lived signed dispatch grant); the binding's ZECK_SOCKETIO_URL is the listen/attach coordinate

THE SUBSTITUTION INVARIANT: the five shared failure kinds carry the EXACT same neutral reason strings and codes as the LiveKit table (pinned by a unit test AND asserted by the drill) — a refusal means the same thing on every rail

THE DRILL'S HONEST LABELING: the drill record (logged by the suite) states exactly which rails were real; with the binary absent the primary leg is test.skipIf-skipped with an explicit honest-skip record and the ALTERNATE's proofs stand alone

THE FEASIBILITY PROBE's VERDICT is recorded here per the work order's requirement 0: socket.io serves real acked WebSocket round-trips under bun 1.3.14 + vitest — the primary choice stands, the ws fallback not exercised
